items.title_orig: What kinda music do you play?
items.article_text:
Just curious what people play.
 I have a Playlist of "safe" music from my own library, ranging from , Fleetwood Mac, to Pearl Jam, to Lady Gaga. But I've also been in the back of a couple Ubers that spin some awkward stuff.
 I also made the meme because its happened to me like 4 times now. 🤣
    submitted by    /u/salawle    to    r/uberdrivers  
 [link]   [comments]

Jason and Paul punctuate Election Day in America by looking back 26 years to discuss their favorite albums from the year 2000. The series is called Soundtracking the Year and the guys talk about their personal connections to the albums that shaped them from that year. It was a pivotal year in American politics and one where the world saw the an evolving cyberspace change how we viewed each other and ourselves.
